items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: He said, man, look, can you teach me how to do that? And man, before I knew it, I had all the trumpet teachers, I mean all the trumpet students around to take lessons with me. And guys, and I'll tell you another guy was one of my students. He was too young to go to the school and have the government

ctx.x: He said, look man, look, I don't want Wallace to teach me anything. You don't know what to teach me. So I'm just going to sign your slip that I'm taking a lesson. He wasn't taking a lesson from Willie either. He just signed a slip. So one day I didn't have any students. I went in one of those little practice rooms and had my Auburn Method. And I was playing some triple tonguing and double tonguing exercises. I heard somebody knock at the door. I said, who is it? Hey man, this is Frank. Who's in there playing that…
Milton, okay. Baptiste. Did, I'm thinking of another one, Melvin Lasty.
